profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
At Amazon, I work on the Creators and Influencers program - a platform to easily recommend products to followers, and earn commissions on qualifying purchases.

I've also made contributions to Amazon's digital order history and order details - frontend, backend and operational improvements, to maintain high availability. Order history and order details are highly visited pages serving tens of millions of customers worldwide.

Prior to Amazon, I worked at Akamai on a highly available distributed system in Golang.  I've worked on the core API and CLI to control the Kubernetes Product Platform (KPP), enabling every Akamai cloud computing service's regional failovers and load balancing. This work supported Linode’s ~180,000 customers.

I've also built on KPP's Controller, the core service to handle failover and self-healing clusters. Additionally, I've designed, built, and released mutual TLS support for KPP, becoming an SME on the product's industry-standard secure passage of data.

Prior to KPP, I worked on our Managed Databases cloud service, where I delivered a backups feature to guarantee high-availability for 1,500 customers using a Python backend and Typescript frontend.  I streamlined the process of provisioning and deleting databases in the Python APIs, to remove orphaned databases saving around $24,000 annually.

My primary areas of strength are in distributed systems, operating systems and embedded systems.  I'm skilled in algorithms/data structures, and numerical methods.  I've used C/C++, C#, Golang, Java, Python, Perl, PHP, Typescript, React, Docker, and Kubernetes and will pick up new technologies very fast.

Check out my website for more info: https://ericsund.github.io/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on features related to the Ghost webserver for Akamai's Edge Platform, delivering 1/4 of the world's Internet traffic.

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description: I'll be building frameworks and internal tools for testing, analyzing, reporting and optimizing Akamai Ghost features as part of the Edge Platform.

positions.title: DevOps Engineer Intern
positions.description: Akamai Ghost handles 1/4 of our world's Internet traffic, and I built a CI framework to verify Ghost's certificate functionality.  This framework automatically spun up a distributed system to ensure nightly tests reported no errors in Ghost's secure traffic.  I also worked on Ghost itself to include more information on active certificates in a Dashboard.

positions.title: Chapter Director
positions.description:
• Organized job fairs in Vancouver, BC and Calgary, AB between 10-20 software companies and 50-150 attendees.
• Managed event volunteers to run events in various offices, including
Amazon, SAP, BuildDirect, A Thinking Ape, Urthecast, and numerous Vancouver startups.

positions.title: Event Assistant
positions.description:
• Helped check in attendees
• Oversaw attendee queues and rotations
• Provided snacks and beverages to interviewers

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description:
I tutored undergraduate students in 3 first-year courses:

CMPT 120: (Python) Introduction to Computing Science and Programming I
CMPT 125: (C/C++) Introduction to Computing Science and Programming II
CMPT 127: (C/C++) Computing Laboratory

Worked directly with students to debug their assignments, explain concepts on a whiteboard, and guide them to optimal solutions.

positions.title: Software Developer, Production Operations & Delivery
positions.description:
• Project managed and helped build AWS load balancer infrastructure to handle Dashboard site traffic, increasing reliability, security and high availability resulting in faster load times.

• Created API key rotation tool using depth first search affecting hundreds of keys, improving rotation process measured by saved developer time.

• Built feature flagging tool at a hackathon, improving clarity and decreasing time editing customers’ product features.

• Organized co-op social events.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Python · Ansible · Git · Agile Methodologies · Linux · Terraform

positions.title: BC Tech Assistant Events Organizer
positions.description: Working with BC Tech Jobs to assist in event organization.  Roles include event setup and teardown, space organization/preparation and other interactions with company representatives/presenters.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer Co-op, responsibilities include:

• Restructured tree data structure of Beanworks customers in PHP using Doctrine, DQL, and SQL.
• Became AWS Cloud Practitioner certified
• Helped build invoice payment support for Sage Intacct using PHP in a team (incl. project management).
• Improved SyncTool Windows app in C#, to sync ERP data with Beanworks.
• Led retrospectives, daily standups, and meetings to shadow team lead roles.
• Sat in on junior developers interviews and provided insight to hiring managers.
• Spoke about effective teams during "lunch & learns".
positions.insights: Skills: Java · PHP · Git · HTML5 · Agile Methodologies · Linux · C# · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Part Time Technical Support
positions.description:
Part time technical support involved Tiers I, II, III:

• Providing suggestions and instructions for site design and customization
• Helping customers with technical problems over an email ticketing system
• Investigating and fixing reported bugs in the codebase

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Summer 2017 co-op student roles:

• Built Thinkific's "User Groups" feature as a full-stack developer in a team of two (Riot.js, HAML, Ruby on Rails, Ajax, Sidekiq, Postgres and Rspec).  --  Now used by over 300 customers!
• Frontend bug fixes on Course Builder and Course Player (Ember.js, React.js and HAML)
• Improved Student Dashboard Search, Mixpanel analytics, and Stripe payments (Ruby on Rails and Docker).

• Created QA automation from scratch with a new team (Node.js, Webdriver IO, and Selenium).
• Wrote test cases to perform smoke and regression tests on v2 themes -- rolled out to 1500 users
• Collaborated with managers and QA to define processes to scale a new team


• Provided technical support to customers
• Triaged and fixed bugs on the fly from the customer support queue
• Helped achieve a company-wide support goal

• Presented technical items & team growth techniques at company-wide “lunch & learn” events.

positions.title: QA Developer
positions.description:
Summer internship roles:

• Wrote and contributed to 20+ Python, Bash, cmake and C++ scripts testing PCoIP host & infrastructure quality on major operating systems.
• Extended Automation Test Framework (ATF) functionality to RHEL, AWS, and Azure.
• Developed "Teamcity Messenger” for use by 70-80 developers; a Slack application using the
REST API to query Teamcity build statuses and send corresponding messages.
positions.insights: Skills: Python · C/C++ · Git · Agile Methodologies · Linux
